title: 2220. Calculating Total Marks and Percentage of Three Subjects
description:
ssions
2220
. 
Calculating Total Marks and Percentage of Three Subjects
10
Easy
Problem Statement
Read the marks of a student in three subjects and print the total marks and the percentage.
Description
Read the marks of a student in three subjects, each out of 100. Calculate the total marks and the percentage using the formula percentage = total * 100.0 / 300. Writing 100.0 (and not 100) makes the division use decimals, so the decimal part of the percentage is not lost. Print the total on the first line, and the percentage with exactly two digits after the decimal point on the second line.
Input Description
Three integers m1, m2 and m3 separated by spaces (0 <= each mark <= 100).
Output Description
Print the total marks on the first line and the percentage with two digits after the decimal point on the second line.
Sample Input
80 70 90
Sample Output
240
80.00
